summary: DeSaulnier voted No on successive Israel aid bills through 2025–26, voted Yes on the Massie amendment eliminating $3.3B in military aid, sponsors the Block the Bombs Act, and stated in July 2025 he no longer votes for offensive military aid to Israel. CAIR Action endorsed him; Vote for Peace rated him an Ally. Earlier Yes votes on UNRWA cuts, a PLO entry ban, and the Boulder resolution, along with his non-sponsorship of genocide-recognition, complicate the record.
